Mnemonic Utils
Click the image to download
>>>README<<<Requires LazyLib, MagicLib and LunaLib

"Sensor Officer, is that sensor blip in the distance valuable salvage, or the cargo pods containing metal we dumped earlier?""Sorry Captain, without mnemonic sensors installed, there is absolutely no way to tell these two options apart!"  - Captain's Log, May 3rd, 217th Cycle
A mod containing exploration-themed QoL improvements. Please check the readme for details!
  • Gate Markers
  • Mnemonic Sensors
  • Trash Disposal
  • System & Hyperspace Grid Removal
  • Garage for Rent
  • A few small features
  • Can be added to and removed from ongoing campaigns. If removal doesn't work, disable all features via LunaSettings, save the game and then remove the mod.
  • Fully customizable via LunaSettings

Note: This mod was originally called MnemonicSensors and only contained that feature.
Disclaimer: The image used for Garage for Rent was generated using Craiyon (craiyon.com)

Credits
  • Many thanks to Genir for suggesting and providing sample implementation for system & hyperspace grid removal!
  • Many thanks to Tesser for contributing much prettier icons!
  • Many thanks to Mythic for sponsoring the Garage for Rent feature

aiDescription: Adds a suite of exploration-focused quality-of-life features: mnemonic sensors for better object identification, gate markers, trash disposal tracking, and the ability to remove system and hyperspace grids. Includes a garage for rent feature and several small utilities. Fully customizable via LunaSettings and safe to use in ongoing campaigns with proper removal steps.
saveCompatibilityText: Can be added to and removed from ongoing campaigns. If removal doesn't work, disable all features via LunaSettings, save the game and then remove the mod.
